title: 傅里叶：热流与三角级数挑战函数观念

claims.statement: Fourier heat work presented 21 December 1807; initial scholarly objections including trigonometric representation
Fourier won 1811 prize on heat propagation with committee qualification
Fourier 1822 Théorie analytique de la chaleur first edition
claims.locator: HKUST first edition catalogue and Cambridge translation metadata

claims.statement: 1878 Freeman English translation distinct from original French 1822 edition
u_t=κu_xx with ends fixed zero and initial f(x) yields sine modes
claims.locator: LibreTexts modern heat equation separated variables

claims.statement: single sine mode decays e^{-κ(nπ/L)² t}
claims.locator: direct differentiate in x twice and time once

claims.statement: sum of modes n=1 and n=3 satisfies heat eq and end conditions with 1/3 initial amplitude
n=3 spatial frequency decays 9 times faster in exponent than n=1

claims.locator: sine basis L² orthogonality calculation, conditions qualified

claims.statement: square wave odd sine coefficients 4/(πn) for odd n and 0 for even n
square wave Fourier series equals jump midpoint 0 at x=0 even if original assigned f(0)=1
claims.locator: Brown Fourier theorem for piecewise regular function, pointwise sum

claims.statement: representation and convergence generality are distinct issues in Fourier's 1822 work; not solved for every arbitrary function
discontinuous functions can remain Riemann integrable, hence next chapter studies integrability conditions
claims.locator: modern finitely discontinuous bounded functions example; historical bridge

caveats: 1807研究、1811获奖、1822出版三节点准确区分，不声称Cauchy 1821直接启发Fourier 1807。
有限棒零温边界和周期方波为不同数学模型，不能混用。
热方程、正弦模态、方波系数与跳点收敛为现代教材推导，不冒称1822原文逐句。
分段光滑条件下跳点取平均，不对任何任意函数声称无条件点态重建。
原版逐页校勘及独立双审尚未完成。
